name: console-01-signin
prompt: Turn this sign-in page into the sign-in page of the "Smart-Clearance Console", the staff-only console at console.smartclearance.com, edge to edge with no browser window. Keep the reference's visual system and two-column layout: pale sage-white ground, the deep green brand colour, the heavy rounded grotesque headline type, the clean sans text, the white sign-in card with thin hairline edge and soft shadow on the right. Replace all of its content; nothing of Munchly appears on this page. Left column: the green rounded-square S logo and "Smart-Clearance"; a large dark heading "Console" and the line "Set up and run every client's workspace: its agents, its supply chain, its people."; under it a small tilt-shift miniature diorama photograph in a rounded frame showing a tiny Indian town with one giant brown cardboard carton standing in it at dawn. Right column, the white card: the green S logo at the top; "Smart-Clearance staff"; the address "console.smartclearance.com" in a small grey pill with a lock icon; a large heading "Sign in"; the line "Use your smartclearance.com Google account, then your passkey."; a full-width white button with the Google G logo "Continue with Google"; a full-width dark green button "Use a passkey"; a thin divider; a small grey note "Client teams sign in at their own workspace address, such as munchly.smartclearance.com." with a green link "Find a workspace"; at the bottom in small grey text "Prototype · every person and number is fictional". Crisp flat interface; all text legible.
reference: scratchpad hosted/shots2/app.png (the hosted Munchly sign-in at 1440x900, re-pinned 58c6874)
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
